name: ap_akm
source: tests/hwsim/test_eht.py:320; tests/hwsim/test_eht.py:502; tests/hwsim/test_eht.py:692; tests/hwsim/test_eht.py:794; tests/hwsim/test_eht.py:881; tests/hwsim/test_eht.py:2221
notes: Set per AP link. Mixed lists also appear: 'SAE SAE-EXT-KEY' (legacy_stas) and 'SAE-EXT-KEY SAE WPA-PSK WPA-PSK-SHA256' (sae_transition, ptk/gtk rekey). Links normally share one value; see link_akm_mismatch.

name: sta_akm
notes: Mixed client lists ('SAE SAE-EXT-KEY', 'WPA-PSK SAE SAE-EXT-KEY') only in no_common_key_mgmt and invalid_link tests.

name: ap_pmf
notes: Default 2. 1 appears with the mixed AKM list (sae_transition, ptk/gtk rekey). No MLD test uses 0.

name: sta_pmf
notes: Only value used, even when the AP uses mfp=1: a fixed setting, not a dimension.

name: ap_beacon_protection
notes: Only run_eht_mld_sae_two_links varies it; elsewhere the helper default 1. Observable as station_status.bigtk_set (1 in the baseline runs).

name: sta_beacon_protection
notes: Only value used (also when the AP has beacon_prot=0): fixed.

name: ap_sae_pwe
notes: Only set with SAE-family AKMs; never with OWE.

name: sta_sae_pwe
notes: 2 appears only in eht_assoc_failure (line 1282), a deliberate failure test.

name: sta_sae_groups
notes: eht_mld_sae_two_links expects group 20 to fail and 19 to succeed. Observable as station_status.sae_group (19 in the baseline runs).

name: ap_pairwise_cipher
notes: Only changed on one link in a mismatch test (GCMP-256 on link 0).

name: link_akm_mismatch
values: link0 WPA-PSK|link0 SAE-EXT-KEY|link0 SAE + link1 SAE-EXT-KEY
notes: Implementation evidence for a per-link AKM rule: invalid_link* expect association on link 1 only (valid_links=2); no_common_key_mgmt fails if the client connects to both links. This is hostap's behavior, not a spec citation.

name: ap_mld_link_count
hostap_option_or_helper: eht_mld_enable_ap(iface, link_id, params) once per link
notes: Scenario tests use 2 links.

name: ap_link_channel
example_tests: two-link tests (link 0 = channel 1 / 2412 MHz, link 1 = channel 6 / 2437 MHz)
notes: 5/6 GHz tests exist in test_eht.py but the spec excludes 6 GHz/320 MHz.

name: ap_link_indicate_disabled
notes: With 1 on link 1 the test expects dormant_links=2 and active_links=1 (lines 527-531).

name: link_remove

name: ap_deauthenticate
